logical_classification.hpcx_equivalence: H-PCX iff classical polynomial-time exact parity iff classical polynomial-time ECDLP for the declared family
logical_classification.hrpcx_strength: H-RPCX implies H-PCX and additionally requires recovery in a fixed effective feature language
logical_classification.effectivity_dichotomy: representation-free existential compression is tautological; fully effective compression is already the target algorithm
logical_classification.canonical_cut_equivalence: after public division by two, parity is exactly lower-half versus upper-half classification of the canonical scalar

hypothesis.name: H-PCX
hypothesis.claim: parity factors through a uniformly constructible public state of dimension and total cost polynomial in log(n)

recoverability_extension.name: H-RPCX
recoverability_extension.claim: the compact state is spanned by a fixed effectively enumerable public feature family with polynomial descriptions and exact full-rank recoverability

proved_boundaries.claim: exact parity on every odd cycle has full n-dimensional cyclic shift span
consequences: no proper linear translation-invariant subspace contains exact parity
no cyclic constant-coefficient linear recurrence of order less than n
all n additive Fourier characters are required

proved_boundaries.claim: every autonomous deterministic exact parity transport state is injective and has at least n states
consequences: two-, three-, and six-phase autonomous transports are impossible
constant or poly(log n)-cardinality phase automata are impossible

proved_boundaries.claim: in one primitive character coordinate the minimum rational parity degree is exactly (n+1)/2
consequences: poly(log n)-degree one-character rational decoders are impossible
the exact representation is controlled by even and odd half-cycle products

proved_boundaries.claim: a degree-d rational map taking at most s values on N target points satisfies N<=s*d unless constant
consequences: direct rational parity degree is at least n/2
direct four-state W_G degree is at least n/4
polylog-degree finite-image rational states are impossible

proved_boundaries.claim: small recurrence width does not imply compression without a poly(log n) jump-ahead evaluator
consequences: local transition cost and state width must be separated from total target-index work
every recurrence candidate must prove polylog random access

proved_boundaries.claim: parity equals detection of the canonical lower or upper half after public halving
consequences: the missing information is a global ordering cut
local invariants without a public orientation mechanism are insufficient

promotion_rule: Do not promote H-PCX to theorem until all full-cost obligations are discharged; restricted closure theorems must remain scoped to their declared representation class.
